name: hiyoriclaw
description: Hiyoriclaw desktop pet using Electron, TypeScript, and Live2D.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch" "tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --watch" "bash -lc 'if curl -fsS http://localhost:5173 > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"[dev] Reusing existing Vite server on 5173\"; else vite --port 5173 --strictPort; fi'" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 dist/main/main.js dist/preload/preload.js && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && vite build
